tools.name: workable_list_accounts
tools.description: List the Workable accounts this API token can access, with the subdomain and name. Good first call to confirm the connection. GET /accounts.

tools.name: workable_list_stages
tools.description: List the account's recruitment pipeline stages (slug, name, kind). Use the slugs as stage filters and as target_stage in workable_move_candidate. GET /stages.

tools.name: workable_list_disqualification_reasons
tools.description: List the account's disqualification reasons. Read-only reference data. GET /disqualification_reasons.

tools.name: workable_list_members
tools.description: List the account's hiring team members (id, name, email, roles, status). Use a member id as member_id when writing a comment or moving a candidate. GET /members.

tools.name: workable_list_jobs
tools.description: List the account's jobs (shortcode, title, state, created and updated times). Filter by state or by time. GET /jobs.

tools.name: workable_get_job
tools.description: Get one job by its shortcode, with its full details. GET /jobs/{shortcode}.

tools.name: workable_list_job_stages
tools.description: List the recruitment pipeline stages of one job, in order. GET /jobs/{shortcode}/stages.

tools.name: workable_list_recruiters
tools.description: List the account's external recruiters, optionally for one job. Read-only. GET /recruiters.

tools.name: workable_list_candidates
tools.description: List candidates, optionally for one job, one stage or one email address. Returns name, stage, job and time fields. GET /candidates.

tools.name: workable_get_candidate
tools.description: Get one candidate by id: profile, job, stage, tags, disqualification state and source. GET /candidates/{id}.

tools.name: workable_list_candidate_activities
tools.description: List the activity stream of one candidate (stage moves, comments, ratings, emails). GET /candidates/{id}/activities.

tools.name: workable_list_events
tools.description: List scheduled calls, interviews and meetings, with their start and end times and the candidate and job. GET /events.

tools.name: workable_add_candidate_comment
tools.description: WRITE: post a comment on a candidate's timeline, as the given team member. Visible to the hiring team. POST /candidates/{id}/comments.

tools.name: workable_move_candidate
tools.description: WRITE: move a candidate to another pipeline stage, as the given team member. Moving to a hired stage is refused: hiring stays in Workable. Moving to the same stage again changes nothing. POST /candidates/{id}/move.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: workable_list_members, workable_list_candidates, workable_list_candidate_activities · Private data: workable_list_accounts · Public sink: workable_list_members, workable_list_candidates, workable_add_candidate_comment, workable_move_candidate.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: workable_list_members, workable_list_candidates, workable_list_candidate_activities · Private data: workable_list_accounts · Public sink: workable_list_members, workable_list_candidates, workable_add_candidate_comment, workable_move_candidate

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
